name: Imgix partial outage and rendering errors

updates.content: Earlier today, from approximately 15:00 to 19:00 UTC, our upstream image provider (Imgix) had a partial outage that resulted in occasional rendering errors for some customers in some situations. The issue should now be resolved (see details at https://status.imgix.com/incidents/ch5p1nlqnckd and https://status.imgix.com/incidents/7n22y1mt7jw1
Separate from the Imgix outage, our status page (this current page) is not correctly showing our upstream provider statuses. We are investigating.
